entry.title: TR-MPC Tap FX 1.2.1
entry.summary: **MPC OS 3.10.1 folder format.** Same plugin as trmpc-tap-fx-vst-v1.2.0 (binaries, skins and data byte-identical); the plugin folder now carries a `plugin.json`, so it can be copied straight into `VST2 Plugins` on MPC OS 3.10.1, and the new **`-mpc-sdk.zip`** is one folder for every MPC (Gen1, Gen2 and the Force). The Plugin Manager and the installer app install it on every MPC OS as before.

entry.title: TR-MPC Tap FX 1.2.0
entry.summary: Packaging update: this release is a single plugin folder for both MPC families (ARM 32-bit and 64-bit) instead of two separate zips. Same sound engine, same skin, same parameters and presets as the previous version. Nothing about the plugin itself has changed. Install: unzip and copy the `... - VST - <name>` folder into your plugin folder (Live III / One: `VST2 Plugins`; Force and other 32-bit models: the existing plugin folder).

entry.title: TR-MPC Tap FX 1.1.0
entry.summary: TR-MPC Tap FX - sends any TR-MPC slot, or its reverb or delay send, out on its own MPC track so MPC's mixer, submixes and effects can process it. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force. entry.title: TR-MPC Tap FX 1.0.1
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.
